newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur to set Catastrophe bond.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur to set Catastrophe bond.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co said a 300 million Swiss franc three-year, subordinated convertible bond it plans to set later on Wednesday will be the first public launch of a catastrophe-linked bond issue.
Winterthur financial officer Erwin Heri said at a presentation that the issue will carry a 2-1/4 percent coupon and that the conversion premium will amount to about seven percent per annum.

But no interest will be paid on the bond if during the observation period betweeb November 1 and October 31 of the following year, Winterthur has to compensate 6,000 or more vehicles it insures in Switzerland or hail or storm based motor vehicle damage.
The issue price on the bond will be 100 percent and the conversion price will be fixed on January 16, 1997. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
